action: Two setups either side of a cut, and the cut is the point: Bank against a blank pale wall, looking off at something outside the frame, then Lynn behind a glass partition, glancing down and turning with her mouth open. The film does not put them in one frame - pass one found them in two different rooms, and the beat (B72, 01:49:20) has them one room apart. The denial is SPOKEN earlier inside that beat, not in this window, so a writer who wants the line has to go upstream; what this window carries is the shape the denial leaves, and it carries it unevenly - pass one records no expression on him and open-mouthed alarm on her, so all the fear is on her side of the glass. Ten seconds across two setups in a film whose median shot is three: both halves are being let sit. Guardrail (R2): at this point the denial still reads as Bank taking the fall for her, and nothing in this shot may be used as the first sign of the turn.
